Let me be honest with you about something.
I'm not supposed to be in this race.
The grandson of a sharecropper? Not supposed to be a viable Senate candidate in Louisiana.
A Black farmer from rural Tensas Parish? Not supposed to compete statewide in the Deep South.
Someone without billionaire backers or a Rolodex full of Washington insiders? Not supposed to have a shot at flipping a Senate seat.
But here we are.
**And MAGA is absolutely shocked.**
They thought Louisiana was locked up. They thought they could focus on defending seats in swing states while the South stayed safely red. They thought a race like ours — a real populist challenge to their grip on power — wasn't possible here.
They were wrong.
Look at what's happening: Democrats flipping Trump districts across the South. MAGA candidates tearing each other apart in primaries. Republican retirements at levels not seen since the Great Depression. Trump's approval cratering over his failed Iran war.
This is a once-in-a-lifetime opening. The kind of moment that doesn't come around often in Louisiana politics.
**_And I believe — deep in my bones — that this is the campaign to meet this moment._**
Not because I'm the most polished politician. Not because I've been planning a Senate run my whole career. But because I understand what working Louisianans need because I've lived their struggles.
I know what it's like to watch costs rise while your income stays flat. I know what it's like to compete against corporations that rig the system against family operations. I know what it's like to worry about whether there will be anything left for the next generation.
That's the authentic economic populism that can win here. Not the fake MAGA version that delivers nothing but culture wars — the real thing that actually fights for working people.
And if we capitalize on this moment — if we show the political world that Louisiana is genuinely winnable — everything changes.
Not just for this race. For the entire map. For what's possible in the South.
But only if we have the resources to compete. And that counts on good folks like you stepping up.

clean_body: MAGA is shocked we're competitive. A Black farmer from rural Louisiana isn't supposed to threaten their Senate seat. But here we are. | | | = Let me be honest with you about something. I'm not supposed to be in this race. The grandson of a sharecropper? Not supposed to be a viable Senate candidate in Louisiana. A Black farmer from rural Tensas Parish? Not supposed to compete statewide in the Deep South. Someone without billionaire backers or a Rolodex full of Washington insiders? Not supposed to have a shot at flipping a Senate seat. But here we are. And MAGA is absolutely shocked. They thought Louisiana was locked up. They thought they could focus on defending seats in swing states while the South stayed safely red. They thought a race like ours — a real populist challenge to their grip on power — wasn't possible here. They were wrong. Look at what's happening: Democrats flipping Trump districts across the South. MAGA candidates tearing each other apart in primaries. Republican retirements at levels not seen since the Great Depression. Trump's approval cratering over his failed Iran war. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opening. The kind of moment that doesn't come around often in Louisiana politics. And I believe — deep in my bones — that this is the campaign to meet this moment. Not because I'm the most polished politician. Not because I've been planning a Senate run my whole career. But because I understand what working Louisianans need because I've lived their struggles. I know what it's like to watch costs rise while your income stays flat. I know what it's like to compete against corporations that rig the system against family operations. I know what it's like to worry about whether there will be anything left for the next generation. That's the authentic economic populism that can win here. Not the fake MAGA version that delivers nothing but culture wars — the real thing that actually fights for working people. And if we capitalize on this moment — if we show the political world that Louisiana is genuinely winnable — everything changes. Not just for this race. For the entire map. For what's possible in the South. But only if we have the resources to compete. And that counts on good folks like you stepping up. = | | = We have the opportunity to pull off something historic in Louisiana that will do a whole lot of good for people here. I couldn’t be more grateful to have you fighting alongside me. body:
This could be my last 4 weeks with you and the MAGA Movement.
| | | |
# **FAREWELL TO TRUMP**
---
[](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
This was hard to write.
**_In just 4 weeks, we might have to say goodbye to each other forever..._**
That’s if we lose the Congressional Majority on Election Night.
On day 1, Democrats will file the Articles of Impeachment against me for the THIRD TIME. But this time, they will have the votes — the votes to lock me out of the White House and throw away the key.
**_Could you even begin to fathom MAGA without Trump??_**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
Once they kick me out, they’ll reverse everything I’ve done to Make America Great Again over the past two years.
Borders will open and criminal illegal aliens will flood into our country AGAIN.
Cities like Washington DC will roar with crime AGAIN.
Social Security tax will go up to an all time high AGAIN.
And this time, the American dream might slip away for every young American and all future generations to come.
This will break my heart.
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
My job is far from over, and the last thing I want is for the Democrats to unleash terror on the great American people.
**_[So I am asking you, from the bottom of my heart, not to let them do it.](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)_**
[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)
You have stood with me when nobody else would. You have taken the hits, the insults, the lies, and you have never backed down. That’s why we’re still here. That’s why America still has a chance.
But four weeks is nothing. If our people sit this one out, it is over. No second chance. No do-over. They get the Majority, and they’ll obliterate all of the hard work that we’ve accomplished.
I need you in this fight. Not later. Now. One gift from you keeps our Majority alive and keeps me in this office, fighting for you.
Please. Do not make me say goodbye. Stand with me one more time.

[STAND WITH TRUMP](https://link.win.donaldjtrump.)

Case File No DRT-ED-2NDCHECK · Special File · The Second Paycheck
Fewer Americans Have a Side Income Now. The Ones Who Do Are Earning More Than Ever.
The average side income hit $1,242 a month this year, up 163% since 2022. At the same time, gasoline is up 27% in a year. The gap between households with a second paycheck and those without one is getting wider.
Threat level 3/5 — Guarded
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
Something strange is happening with extra income in America. You’d expect that with prices still rising, more people would be picking up a second paycheck. The opposite is happening. Fewer people have one. But those who do are making much more from it than they were a few years ago.
The evidence board
| | The Numbers Behind the Second Paycheck
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the pay.** LendingTree’s 2026 survey of more than 2,000 U.S. adults found the average side income is now $1,242 a month, up from $473 in 2022. That’s an increase of 163% in four years.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the people.** Only 33% of Americans have a side income this year, down from 38% last year and 44% in 2022.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the need.** 61% of people with a side income told LendingTree their lives would be unaffordable without it.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit D — the pressure.** Consumer prices rose 3.4% over the 12 months to August. Gasoline rose 27.4%. Energy overall rose 16.3%.
| OUR THEORY
---
Put those together and a clear picture forms. Side income has become more serious and better paid, but many people have given up on it, often because the options they tried took too much time, needed a license or paid too little. That leaves more room for the ones who find the right kind of work.
Decoder
| | What People Actually Want
---|---
| | “69% would rather have one reliable income source.”— LendingTree 2026 side hustle survey
---|---
What it says
Most people don’t want to juggle two jobs. They do it because they have to.
What it means
**Our theory:** the best second income doesn’t feel like a second job. It fits around the life you already have, from home, on your own hours, without years of training. That type of work exists, but most people never hear about it.
The mechanism
| | Why a Second Paycheck Matters More in 2026
---|---
| | STEP 1
---
Costs rise first
Fuel, insurance and rent go up quickly. Raises at work usually come later, if they come at all.
| | STEP 2
---
The gap opens
A household with one income absorbs every price increase. A household with two has a cushion.
| | STEP 3
---
The cushion compounds
An extra $1,200 a month is more than $14,000 a year. That can pay down debt, build savings or simply make the month work.
| ClassificationOpportunity, underused
---
The demand for extra income has never been higher, yet fewer people are going after it. That doesn’t mean the opportunity is shrinking. It means the people who know where to look are collecting more of it.
Tripwires
| | What We’re Watching
---|---
| |
---
**October 14:** the September inflation report, and whether energy prices keep climbing.
| |
---
**Holiday season:** whether demand for flexible, part-time work picks up as it usually does.
| |
---
**Household savings:** any sign that more families are running short by month’s end.
| The riddle · answer at the end of the fileSide income pays more than ever, yet fewer Americans have one. How can both be true?
---
|
---
Riddle answer
**Because many people quit after trying the wrong thing.** Jobs that need a license, special training or long hours push people out, and those who stay earn more. **Our theory:** the real advantage goes to people who find extra income that is simple to start and fits around their life.

Case File No DRT-ED-FREMONT · Special File · The Converted Line
Tesla Tore Out Its Oldest Car Line in Fremont. What’s Being Built There Now Could Make Small Suppliers Very Valuable.
Tesla ended the Model S and Model X to make room for a line designed for 1 million humanoid robots a year. Reports say output is already in the hundreds per week, and Tesla reports again on October 21. The bottleneck isn’t demand. It’s parts.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
For 14 years, the Model S was the car that made Tesla. This year, Tesla shut its line down on purpose. The space in Fremont, California, is being turned over to something Elon Musk clearly thinks matters more than a luxury sedan: Optimus, Tesla’s humanoid robot.
The evidence board
| | What We Know
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the decision.** In January, Tesla said it would end Model S and Model X production and convert that space into a robot line designed for up to 1 million units a year.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the bigger plan.** In April, Tesla said a second-generation line at its Texas factory is being designed for 10 million robots a year, with production targeted for 2027.
| CHATTER
---
**Exhibit C — the ramp.** According to a report by The Information, summarized by Electrek in late September, Tesla is now building several hundred robots a week in Fremont, about 10 times its second-quarter pace, and managers want more than 1,000 a week by year-end. Tesla hasn’t confirmed these numbers.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit D — the date.** Tesla reports third-quarter results on Wednesday, October 21, after the market closes, with a live call.
The detail most people miss
| | The Hard Part Is the Parts
---|---
| CHATTER
---
The same report says the robot’s hand and forearm contain more than 100 screws and small components, some still assembled by hand. Motors and precision gears come from outside suppliers, and some of them make good prototype parts but struggle to keep quality consistent at high volume.
| OUR THEORY
---
That’s the story inside the story. When a product jumps from hundreds to thousands to millions, the companies that can reliably supply the small, precise parts become critical, and the market often notices them late. Many of these suppliers are much smaller than Tesla, so the same order can mean far more to them.
Decoder
| | The Weak Spot, in Their Own Words
---|---
| | “Can’t yet reliably handle a wide range of tasks.”— People familiar with Tesla’s robot AI, as reported by The Information
---|---
What it says
The robot’s software still has a long way to go before it can do any job you give it.
What it means
**Our theory:** that’s exactly why the near-term story is about hardware. Software can be updated overnight. Motors, gears and sensors have to be manufactured, one unit at a time. Think back to the early iPhone: when it took off, hundreds of suppliers making screens, chips, cameras and tiny parts rode the same wave.
House odds
| | What Tesla Says on October 21
---|---
A firm Optimus production or reveal date **35%**
| |
---|---
Upbeat robot comments, no hard numbers **45%**
| |
---|---
A delay or a lower target **20%**
| |
---|---
Our best guesses. The three add up to 100%.
| ClassificationRamp in progress
---
The doubts are real: Tesla has missed robot deadlines before, and its AI still struggles outside the tasks it’s trained for. But the line is built, the parts are being ordered, and the suppliers are already being tested at volume. For investors, that may matter more than any single demo.
Tripwires
| | What We’re Watching
---|---
| |
---
**October 21:** any robot production numbers or timeline in Tesla’s results.
| |
---
**The first outside customers:** Tesla reportedly plans to lease robots to a short list of companies.
| |
---
**Supplier hints:** smaller parts makers mentioning humanoid orders.
| The riddle · answer at the end of the fileTesla builds the robot, but it doesn’t make every part inside it. Who gets paid on every unit, whichever version wins?
---
|
---
Riddle answer
**The suppliers.** Motors, gears, sensors and chips have to be bought for every robot that comes off the line. **Our theory:** in a manufacturing ramp, the small companies that make hard-to-produce parts can see their business change faster than the big brand they supply.

## **Imagine Losing to Someone Who Barely Campaigns.**
---
Scott Fitzgerald has over **$1.3 million in campaign cash** , yet I've seen little evidence of an active reelection campaign in Wisconsin's 5th District.
Campaign signs from previous elections. Very little campaign literature. Virtually no advertising. And where are the town halls and opportunities to hear directly from constituents?
**Look at the money.** According to Federal Election Commission reports covering January 2025 through July 22, 2026:
* **$1.33 million** sitting in Fitzgerald's campaign account.
* **$250,000** transferred to other authorized political committees.
* **$872,100** received from other political committees, compared with **$486,504** from individual contributors.
* In our earlier review of his reported expenditures, we identified approximately **$30 in advertising** and **$2,889 in campaign materials**.

Fitzgerald has spent substantial money operating and fundraising for his campaign. **But where is the visible effort to earn another two years representing us?**
**It would be a shame to lose this election to an incumbent who appears to be doing so little to actively campaign for his own seat.**
I'm doing things differently. We're running a grassroots campaign, meeting voters, discussing the issues, and getting our message out through radio, digital advertising, and billboards.
But reaching voters costs money, and we don't have a million-dollar campaign account.
**With just 24 days until Election Day, I need your help.**
Every $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford helps us reach more people across the district.**[PLEASE DONATE TODAY](https://gbw1f.r.ag.d.sendibm3.com/mk/cl/f/sh/SMK1E8tHeFuBnCiEKhmxTFyzImlN/sOwQzk54hobi)**
Let's make sure Wisconsin's 5th District has a real conversation about who represents us in Washington.
Thank you for standing with me.Andy

[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
Hi there, it’s
Jocelyn Benson.

We’re just 23 days away from Election Day, and I could use your help.
[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/20903?amount=25&t=1001&akid=1980%2E181023%2EbU6U9U ]Will you step up today and
make your first contribution to our campaign?

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/20903?amount=25&t=1002&akid=1980%2E181023%2EbU6U9U ]Donate →

At the end of the day, I’m in this race to do three simple things: drive
down costs of everything from healthcare to housing to energy to
childcare, build our economy to grow wages, and protect our communities
whether it’s at the ballot box, in schools, or at houses of worship.

I believe everyone deserves a fair shot in life, and that’s exactly why
I’m running to make Michigan a place where everyone can stay and thrive.

But I can’t do it alone. I’m proud to be building a campaign powered not
by billionaires or corporate PACs but with the support of thousands of
everyday
people —
because that’s exactly who I’m running to represent.

We’re up against an opponent who has accepted $6 million from the DeVos

I wanted to give you a look at what’s happening on the trails as we gear
up for November 3rd.

Here’s the rundown:

At the end of September, we met with Democratic groups across New
Hampshire. Their support is critical to winning this election.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261011_1.1dHDzF&refcode=em20261011-1&t=1004&akid=9460%2E582294%2EamuOx1 ]Chris meeting with Democratic group

Then we welcomed Pete Buttigieg back to the Granite State. With 23 days to
go, we need everyone on board to help us win this thing.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261011_1.1dHDzF&refcode=em20261011-1&t=1005&akid=9460%2E582294%2EamuOx1 ]Chris and Pete Buttigieg with a group of supporters

More recently Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock helped us open up a new
campaign office in the Keene area. Just look at that packed room!

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261011_1.1dHDzF&refcode=em20261011-1&t=1006&akid=9460%2E582294%2EamuOx1 ]Chris and Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock with a group of supporters

We’re building the kind of grassroots movement it takes to win a swing
state like New Hampshire.

There’s one problem: We are up against a mountain of cash that Republicans
are spending on the airwaves. It’s nearly impossible to keep up with, but
if we have enough small-dollar donations, we can outwork them.

We can’t win this thing without the grassroots support of folks like
you.

So I need to ask one more time: [ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261011_1.1dHDzF&refcode=em20261011-1&t=1007&akid=9460%2E582294%2EamuOx1 ]Will you chip in $5 or
any amount today to help us defend New Hampshire’s Senate seat? Every
dollar donated will go directly towards stopping the GOP from flipping the
Granite State red.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261011_1.1dHDzF&amount=5&refcode=em20261011-1&t=1026&akid=9460%2E582294%2EamuOx1 ]Donate $5 »

I hope to see some of you on the trail.

Thank you,

Chris Pappas

body:
Latinos will flip TX-15, but only if they show up to vote.
#
**Democratic nominee for Texas’s 15th Congressional District, Bobby Pulido, is leading his opponent in the polls, Peter.**
[****](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261011-1.zl2_mY&amount=3&refcode=em20261011-668&t=1&akid=668%2E1366028%2EqKVY6u)
TX-15 has become one of the most contested districts in the country. Monica De La Cruz flipped it in 2022, ending over a century of Democratic representation.
Now, voters are paying the price — soaring housing costs, rising gas prices, and unaffordable essentials. They're seeing right through De La Cruz's empty promises, and they're ready for change. This is a district ripe for the taking — but only with your support.
Latinos make up 71% of the electorate in Texas’s 15th Congressional District, and if we can ensure our community shows up from October 19th through Election Day, we can help Bobby Pulido win. But that requires resources to fund our voter mobilization efforts in South Texas.

Dehumanization has long been used as a tool of psychological warfare. In the prelude to the Rwandan Genocide, Hutus used the label "cockroach" for years to dehumanize their Tutsi neighbors. While we hope that things don't get anywhere near that bad in the United States, it's hard to not see the same pattern.
The term that Democrats use to dehumanize their fellow Americans is _racist!_ , which is used to bully and manipulate us. So-called progressives even insist that we prove that we're _anti-racist_. They've used it so much for so long that the term has lost any impact. If not wanting my neighbors to start passing out the machetes means I'm racist, then suddenly I don't care what names you call me.
But don't tell this to Kelly Kirschner, who is running as a Democrat for Florida's 16th Congressional District. Kirschner has some serious explaining to do to voters in St. Petersburg, Florida, which he wants to represent. Old X posts reveal that the BLM fanboy loves calling his neighbors "racist."
Kirschner has frequently embraced white guilt while cozying up to Hutu-esque race hustlers like Ibram X. Kendi and 1619 Project founder Nikole Hannah-Jones. In February 2023, Kirschner posted:
"I grew up a racist in St. Petersburg."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f28369f9-a136-4d8e-a411-36979efe9c5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Kirschner's "St. Petersburg is racist" post is far from the only radical piece of race-war propaganda on his X account. In August 2020, Kirschner posted:
"It should not be so difficult for so many Christians to affirm that yes, Black lives matter, without conditions or complaints. 'We are being called to love our neighbor.'"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ff90c50d-4c90-4661-a652-87aa6d5892ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Kirschner conveniently missed that Christians invented abolition. He's also never mentioned anything about the [Trans-Saharan slave trade](https://substack.com/redirect/e2963029-8c79-422e-bc1a-6632f6f4cc39?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), where Muslims enslaved as many as 14 million Africans (and basically [still enslave them today](https://substack.com/redirect/63bde705-cb55-4cb6-bc99-1f01138cbc9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
But Kirschner's extreme racialism doesn't stop there. Kirschner also supports race war-baiting as required high school reading, posting in June 2024:
"#requiredReading for all Public officials, HS/College students and the rest of us in America from #pulitzer winner @nhannahjones If we accept our collective obligation to be anti-racist, then this truth must b told and reconciliation must b made real."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/47ddc743-666e-4399-963a-026cab695286?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Kirschner also shared Hannah-Jones' writings to his X account, once posting:
"GUEST EDITORIAL: It isn't enough not to be a racist; be an anti-racist - Sarasota Herald-Tribune - Sarasota, FL Thx @DrIbram and @nhannahjones for your writing & scholarship calling out more of these conversations in cmties around the world."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4236d614-0582-47ee-bfd7-14f5091d29a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Kirschner is also a supporter of Kendi, once posting that he was "honored to welcome" Kendi to St. Petersburg.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ea076467-e9a5-481f-8bd0-219dc339a3e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Kirschner has developed a history of calling President Trump racist, posting criticism of Trump for stopping the BLM/Antifa 2020 riots:
"Former General 'Disappointed' More Republicans Have Not Condemned Trump's Protest Response."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d6be9fd3-ac7c-4dc9-b566-05502f1ec418?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
For some reason, he didn't want to tweet a picture of the President receiving [a civil rights award alongside Rosa Parks](https://substack.com/redirect/6f869235-49c3-451c-a43b-a393f50194e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). name: Pete Buttigieg
subject: We have to keep Michigan’s Senate seat blue
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abdul for U
body:
[](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261011-2-ak.HwTHi5&amount=10&refcode=em20261011-3466&t=2&akid=3518%2E251025%2Emub05y)
Hi Peter, it’s Pete Buttigieg.
Last year, no one really thought we could flip the U.S. Senate. Now, it’s clearly possible. But it’s also clear from the map that the path to a Democratic majority runs through Michigan. Abdul El-Sayed's race for this seat is likely to be the tipping-point contest that will decide control of the entire chamber.
Since making my home in Traverse City, I've seen how Michigan captures everything about American life, from the auto towns that remind me of where I grew up, to the cherry orchards Up North where our family lives, to one of the world's great major cities in Detroit. When it comes to a campaign like this, I experience the stakes not just as an American, but as someone who has made a home here.
[**Before I say more about why this race matters so much, I wanted to ask: will you chip in $10 to Abdul's campaign today to help him reach voters across Michigan in these final weeks?**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261011-2-ak.HwTHi5&amount=10&refcode=em20261011-3466&t=3&akid=3518%2E251025%2Emub05y)
**[Donate $10 ››](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261011-2-ak.HwTHi5&amount=10&refcode=em20261011-3466&t=4&akid=3518%2E251025%2Emub05y)**
When it comes to the U.S. Senate, the choice is clear. Abdul El-Sayed insists that we need reform to get money out of politics, and Mike Rogers insists on being part of the problem. Abdul is campaigning for universal health care and to put more money in your pocket. Mike Rogers voted against the Affordable Care Act and will cut your health care again if he makes it to the Senate.
Mike Rogers and Congressional Republicans think it's perfectly fine for teachers, nurses, and firefighters to pay a higher tax rate than the wealthiest individuals and biggest corporations in America. Abdul knows we can and must do better than cutting Medicaid, cutting SNAP, and gutting Head Start while inventing new tax breaks for corporations.
No two people agree on absolutely everything. But on these big issues, Democrats agree on what we ought to do, most Michiganders agree on what we ought to do, and so do a lot of independents and people who usually vote Republican. We have a chance to do something about it, and a Senate majority is how we do it.
Michigan races are always close, and with 23 days until Election Day, this one will come down to which campaign can reach the most voters.
[**If you can, I hope you'll make a contribution to Abdul's campaign today and help make sure Michigan sends a Democrat to the Senate:**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261011-2-ak.HwTHi5&amount=10&refcode=em20261011-3466&t=5&akid=3518%2E251025%2Emub05y)

Thank you,
Pete Buttigieg

**Whatever happened to the great American road trip?** There was a time when hitting the open road after college wasn't just a vacation. It was a rite of passage. A used car, a folded map or an [AAA TripTik](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykk8-PmzoQx_8a55bIYxsDBw7skuS9l5fdbpsqbS_IgQk4AcwaBzb96ytgVak99FIfrPn5nc9I9nGf7pWudFM8qRojdzZpg0NXoXNoU90prbqr6VozoL0itropzlZjyiiTS6BLgFRlTveYCrXIozMiQ77ACPwQfOA0EIsyogxOlHoMKeZcCA5egPR0OvuMKQikv9DRqAcUACgVgq8U0sznp-AsGfjoKSIo5toZu7oY3bgSz9Xd9GhXmakXVVQ613aEx4RtCNsMw7DCk7qPScI22o0359KXICWlISN8k5UN4UnbESZTZ6-tsnVHeKK71hLm8QQIk6rOlVOEJ9hkYzCGcL17qMKv_3zcPB8vtNx9u71t94UICZONsSMQmVvrK_bup211TnjiAyzB5-DBMgTOBSy9KZtNWTbZ3ewAHRu1w3pyf2Fn0ilboJu7hAdS-l7IA_AJkzn2OkPCk2ySc_d2dNpKESYLY4oKK5MRnoSUBSEb57dGE54QJjNVt0oXzbsuBBB4FJg_CRXW3NoZLZSSCgE0DEZGW3Vq5pnnLH8nUqfs33mlAHgg5CiHNitVM28AwCUwyYORUOVpZ2522gDeA3_gKk5WTWEajydJX5Iy3K6H50vRB9XRu-hC9W_5-Zrdx-qsmoofL8PuMb4MRv1_fCjj41oPcXPX7vbd7bT3uR228at5_u8gr6-3em8PX9KN3da7o8JeNJdXdl0-HQP2IfTg6XB4M4-bT8NL3Cfpw7Be2ChvB11VupM-EbSola6mN-r-8mv1EfsRAAD__1cMIJA), a tank of gas, and 3,000 miles of whatever came next. The whole point was having no point at all. Jack Kerouac set the template with his [1957 novel _On the Road_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb8GtiA_22AzeOiSLV07ood5Jq8xGNlWUP6-StU_6Hp1dY50vm7TDTnyvn7iRq6GNO10lki1Up64IGN5pHKkk_KD6OB9DZlpkkIOFxAXgAl95SdNGtvFBSJJqiUHZgQDSljd3p1GHIQYtTSocLC6n2FWipS2wQdC27J780AAgBBaqw5JeKNmGwYJhnpstKCFa8rdd-K93inEV3pS7nza2ujutR6lUR-NvDbyWmrKrw2P0mH2K5f36W9mKo28KtuPZrZG-nHWiyQrRg_k0eshjH0PbXbLcXKMXAbTaLFuyPFXVf9Z6OnkTwAAAP__p415mQ), a restless account of cross-country wandering that turned the highway into a metaphor for freedom. _Easy Rider_ carried the spirit to the screen in 1969, _Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas_ gave it a darker edge in 1971, and _National Lampoon's Vacation_ spoofed the family version in 1983. For decades, the road trip was woven into the American story of self-discovery. Then the road changed. The interstates that President Eisenhower championed in 1956 bypassed the old two-lane towns, and Route 66, born in 1926, was officially decommissioned in 1985. [Neon motels and roadside diners](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFuhDAQRL8GOpDX-AxXuEhz3aVNifbMGjZnMLI3oPx9dPcLqUYajeZJ7-s-3pEjb_MnruQkpHGjs0QSoTxyQcbyTGVPJ-Un0c7bHDLTqJW2DagGYEQvfNBosJ5cINLU1eSgv0IPnRpMvTgNFzM8rv5ypTAZBWpCQkuDCpP3QUHN7vUHCgCUMqZrkZTvu8cQrIaeLlgZRRNLyu134k0WCvE3HZRbn9Y6ukVkL1X3UelbpW_nebY5_QhZmxNOknl_7Sp9e7eNtY2PWAr75uBNcKZmTUKxNMs72kXWOrtpPzlGLravjJpX5PimyT8lHU7_BQAA__8lsH69) gave way to chain exits that look the same from coast to coast. And GPS finished what the interstates started. There are no more wrong turns that lead to a little diner you'll never forget, no more arguments over the map in the passenger seat, no more pulling into a gas station to ask for directions from a guy who tells you about a waterfall ten miles up the road. The phone knows exactly where you're going, which means you're never truly wandering. Young Americans, meanwhile, stopped showing up. In 1983, 80% of 18-year-olds held a driver's license. By 2018, [that figure had dropped to about 61%](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLtuhDAQAL_GdCA_OOAKF2noLm1KtJgFNmdsZC-gy9dHl19IP5qR5usxPIA8heUTNrQ8xyHglT0yYxooA0F-xrzHC9MTcaewzIlw0FI3pZKlUgM4phOHGorJzogaTYFWtXfVKiO7ulitMhLA4a2F-1hr04ydam9unLQ0nTMGC7Jvn5JKKSnr2lSA0rVm7OZGqxZvIGqJE3FM1XekwCvO_hVPTJWLW-HtyrxnYT6E7oXur-uqNkzuSC8K-UgQHL5BofuEOR7JYRa6h4Oj0P2Cofwpp0QnhaXMDEyZyeVq5c0XyU77Rd5TblpRy2UD8n9R_uer0-rfAAAA__9ibYE3), according to federal highway data. Many would rather fly to a destination they found on Instagram than drive across America to see what they could find out about life. The road trip itself isn't dead. AAA projected a record 61.4 million Americans would drive for this past Fourth of July. But the trip has gotten older, shorter, and planned down to the last rest stop.

Next month, Route 66 turns 100. The old motels still standing along it are booked solid by travelers looking for something they can't quite name, a time when the journey was the whole point. _Did you ever take a cross-country road trip? What do you remember most? Let us know by replying to this email._

There was a time when hitting the open road after college wasn't just a vacation. It was a rite of passage. A used car, a folded map or an , a tank of gas, and 3,000 miles of whatever came next. The whole point was having no point at all. Jack Kerouac set the template with his , a restless account of cross-country wandering that turned the highway into a metaphor for freedom. Easy Rider carried the spirit to the screen in 1969, Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas gave it a darker edge in 1971, and National Lampoon's Vacation spoofed the family version in 1983. For decades, the road trip was woven into the American story of self-discovery. Then the road changed. The interstates that President Eisenhower championed in 1956 bypassed the old two-lane towns, and Route 66, born in 1926, was officially decommissioned in 1985. gave way to chain exits that look the same from coast to coast. And GPS finished what the interstates started. There are no more wrong turns that lead to a little diner you'll never forget, no more arguments over the map in the passenger seat, no more pulling into a gas station to ask for directions from a guy who tells you about a waterfall ten miles up the road. The phone knows exactly where you're going, which means you're never truly wandering. Young Americans, meanwhile, stopped showing up. In 1983, 80% of 18-year-olds held a driver's license. By 2018, , according to federal highway data. Many would rather fly to a destination they found on Instagram than drive across America to see what they could find out about life. The road trip itself isn't dead. AAA projected a record 61.4 million Americans would drive for this past Fourth of July. But the trip has gotten older, shorter, and planned down to the last rest stop. Next month, Route 66 turns 100. The old motels still standing along it are booked solid by travelers looking for something they can't quite name, a time when the journey was the whole point. At least $9 billion in fraud and stolen taxpayer money, rising crime, and failing schools.

## Talarico Resurfaces at Austin City Limits
Democrat Senate nominee James Talarico [turned up at the Austin City Limits Music Festival](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkT2O3DAMRk9jdxqItKS1Cxdp3G3alAYt0zNM5B9InPHO7QMvkBOkewCBBzx-vz7HT5Ik2_0nrdzr17KPG58lsSrnUSlRlrhnLs-8UOQSaT3WdxnRYjBgDcBIUeXFo6N67ic7d1BzDx8dfEAI1taPPi4YuPF-os55nNvYWk-ujQ47vyBMtfSXDiwAgG2gu8UJmJrgFjchLb6tnOVZdM83fbDyF5UlvfcX51vc1zr1D9WjVM2PCocKh_M8b39eT76OFQ6UVWLiCoerrMLh2JOoxAs5cVTZt4u_veYKJLlvRjNJMr9p5WL-_cHQcTBl2iIbehaVzUTRt0myil4ODJ2ZpsYFCo2BbkbjnJ8N-cabEAhbQs8IUOd-Pk5JSUr4qJy9ryTpO0b_d4RXj38DAAD__-K6nI4) on Friday, his first in-person campaign appearance since Sept. 26. Talarico joined a Sept. 30 forum in Edinburg by video, saying a Dallas urgent care clinic had [diagnosed him with the flu](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAMgJ8mbEFxCFCGDLew9dYbkQlO61OAKnFL-_YnKt0T_Kutz_o-_7lOV-TE2-03ruTlHfdpo6MkEqE8CSbMHPZM5ZkjBioB18f6KZM1ttNgNMCEQfhFk8Nq8bNZBqjIQz9AD11nTHX3g4vQXNCZECLafjatMwiua2fo3eDaiv15DgwAgGlgqMMMhE3nopstxvainKGFZc-13EnojSWmz_6iXId9rZK_izyKan4pOyo7HsdRh7mcHede2fGLKDueI2XHv7hS0f_jdExPjc8ivOnA8tGJV5aiv5AutKGQPruRb5veg-wzZX0aKztW2S-Pg1Pi0vXKmduKnL5W8tNvvrz9FwAA__-_sIw8). His absence quickly became a daily talking point for Republicans. Hours before he reappeared, Republican nominee Ken Paxton's campaign [launched a tipline](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OrDAQhE8DmZFtPAwEDl5CNi_dEPmnDS0ZjOweYG6_YqU9wYYllUr1fV-v6WUw4jb_NytoukKaNjhLBCLIE5loMrqUobxzMA6KM-u-fsokueyY4EyIyTjCAyZlaq8t94OoQYvnIJ6i6zivF932vrODtYMVyvpBWeil9LLzzkHfw6NGfc8JLoQQvBVD46wA03YqKCtNePSV4uCRUm5oAYLLlBA_6YDcuLTWUS9Ee6naf5UcKzme59mEdKkb5C5UcoQIjjBtlRx3c1HaWDTvzS1QGOEecQP2y8oKzgvhNheW8TCRhTsXFuK7ztrvJ8aIpXtWis-rwfhzgf6q7tDyOwAA__-KM4g3) asking Texans to report sightings. "_Texans shouldn't need a hotline to find the man asking for their vote_ ," spokesperson Madison Cercy said. Talarico spokesperson JT Ennis shot back that the candidate was "still alive and meeting with voters." He also noted that Paxton hasn't agreed to [any of the four debates](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCnMR3Iuzg4KVxcQ5drr0SLWQdLBiN7LyRvf0qke4K_Hukbzfy5T3eKKe6P37Sxk1fI085nTSzCZRJKVKLPhevfEshz9bQd27tOqHFoQbcAE3mJT54MNYub9XKDhh3YG1gYBq2b1ZGmYe5Nb9FeEZcezcWzBcKAJiwDNtF9ONAAALqHW-dnYOoHE8yMFC5XZTQvUXLpZGXhF9WQ3vnJpfN5a5JbRY6q-l8KR4XjeZ6dX0veP6nC8cgpSvRV4UhFok-scPwqbeWdhNv_O1vyqUU0Vlvdd8d6NMUtxxlTinWwyujHRjF9S-WnZz0d_gsAAP___bV_XQ) Talarico has accepted. Paxton's campaign renewed its call Friday for a doctor's note. Early voting begins Oct. 19, and Talarico has a CNN town hall in Fort Worth on Wednesday.
## Gilley Fled on Bike, Private Jet
Reports have surfaced that Lee Gilley, the Houston man accused of killing his pregnant wife, [left his Heights home on a bicycle](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbGSnDAQRL9GZLMlCY49AgInZOfUITWI0TL2gChpWI6_d-FfcNxd3fXq_foav5CFt9dPXKnX75jGjc4ipEp5VBTMHFKmcuSIgUrAdV-vMnrrW3AWnBsxKL9pbLCa-8nOnauod8_OPV3bWlstvZ_qz2dt4zPEGWucXOM_2s4Gaifn6sZW3N9zzjrnnK1d9wiTI6zbJjaTx_jxaRpLM2vKD11I6RtLlCu9KT9CWivpF9W9mPqH8YPxw3mejyAc_vglHUXTdreMH24w4wdJAcX44f40fnDW-MF2xg9pkwvSBh6ECF4sQhcIRQVdCI5yZwh75jcqwW9SOBcWgihEvL0g4M6KAuuRZ8qgmVGAN1gwZy4Q0rHpZfxQ5X7eTxbh0j5NY18rsvwj0f818O793wAAAP__asCdBg) and later boarded a private jet in Memphis, according to sources. His ankle monitor sent a tamper alert on May 1, weeks before his capital murder trial. Investigators still don't know how he reached Memphis or whether anyone helped. From Canada, Gilley flew to Milan on forged documents, and an Italian judge [ordered him held](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSpCAQhJ8GM7YYRNTA4BKz_9ILrQGHlTpcLBjXf9_-ynuFP-qgu7q6vz9fyxfGFF_P37jTxN8hLy-6aiJmKgtjwhJ9LlTPEtBT9bgf-6cuWmkrQUmABT3HNy0Gm3Vyah2hoQn6EXqwVqlmm1yncAQ9kAnWtkM39oOxQa09QQDyoYnTXQcKAEC1MD68A8LWmmCcxtANwihaI-fy4I2YvrGG9MlvKg-f9yZNG_NRRftL6Fno-bqux98tn7cp9IyFo08k9Hw_E3pO2WO6lUg-Y0r0kR6PyJjkfpaViuQSMcnzWJFJbvmsnF_yDnyEnvXQSQzQkRmtDM4N0nhQ0rXBSz261huv-jD2TZnW44opxWp7YdRzx5j-D-afgn5P-l8AAAD__9mHkto) as an extreme flight risk. Italy wants assurances he won't face execution, and Harris County prosecutors filed a binding notice in September that they [won't seek the death penalty](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbGOpDAMhp8mdBnFhmE2BcU1dHvtlciTOEu0IUGJGXbe_sS9wjWuPn3Wp__P5_JJMcX89Zs2nuQnlCXz2RKLcF2EEtXoSuV21ECOm6Nt395tQYOjBqMBFnISX7wM1PnpabyFjid4WHjAOBrTrZNnSx9muLtgTW8M2t7ineDZW8Y7BuridOnAAACYHuzNPYGpH4cwPJHC_UMNhn2UUm-ysvAPtZDe5cX15srWpWkV2ZvqfymcFc7ned5ciu4b13I0KfmiFM5XmMI5FUdJ4Xz9VDgbq3CG6-y1NHaHlNq0KznEuulcdMzCWbQU3Zi_tWeSVYdS9Uq1xgs9sry1oz0KJb0d1XPVngNnT1n0uRYdEvvLcBFvhXNXJ7-fMaXYxocazNdGMf2Lkf8d4TXh3wAAAP__CKCfOQ). An Italian court heard new extradition testimony this week but hasn't ruled. Gilley has pleaded not guilty and says he fled because he lost faith in the justice system. Meanwhile, Christa Bauer Gilley's family [filed a wrongful death lawsuit](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGy4yAMRb8Gd2QQcUxSUGxD97bd0iNjYTMPmwzI8fPf77C_sKVGGp17z5-v8QtjivvyGzey_BPyuNNZEzFTGRkTluhzoXqUgJ6qx-29XXXUSg8SlAQY0XP80NhjN9tJzS_oyIJ5gYFhUKpbbT89gzd-AlTea_CP52DgMRk1KDRKP7to2ztQAADqDq-bn4DwPvShnzSGx1P0iubIudx4JaYfrCFd-UPl5vPWJbsyv6u4_xLaCe3O87z5FP23XvNROe_tSmjXigntUvaYhHaNKbQDJbRTpi2I5BJTokvWg2bZAPJdaNlxZ3nGQNKvJVZGOeFBpcqZkFfJZ5YXYakSA1ORmBItNMvvmJpZoV1X7Pw-21gHI3q1bBjTv-z8v84_Vv8NAAD__3bYmJA) to block him from profiting from her death.
## Camp Mystic Lawsuits Cleared to Resume
A federal bankruptcy judge in Houston ruled Friday that the pause on wrongful death lawsuits against Camp Mystic [will end Nov. 9](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbGO2zAMQL9G3hhIlGPHg4cu3q5rR4OWqFitHAUSHV_-vvC1f3DjI4EHPPLXx_xBMcXH_SdtPMpnyPODj5pYhMsslKhElwvXvQRyXB1tz-1dZ9TYgdFgzExO4ovnlho_LtoPpuHR9IPpTddp3ayjt-7WDc5b1LrHxRoi728t9i5ce38zTRxPndHGGKOtGS5uMUy2a0O7IIXrTbWafZRcLrKy8CfVkN75xeXi8takcRV5VmV_KJwUTsdxXP6seT-XCicqEl1ihdNZpnCqQnLilwj-D_9BSDl7hdPv3d8ZXGIqFQ56Q8gFznbY3lWig6Pkxz3sCTyTrJDoqHuUCpLhPNbG8MgvGBROeLsCeu473VroLbbQmqWDoTcEGtG5YF0gZ5sy-ucRU4q161Wr7xvF9NUn3_3La8S_AQAA___qEKNL). Floodwaters killed 25 campers, two counselors, and owner Richard "Dick" Eastland at the Hill Country girls' camp on July 4, 2025. Families' suits [have been on hold](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuozAQRb_GdCCPIWAKF9vQZdst0WCGZBSDkT2B8PervF949ZXu0Tn_7uMdOfD2-IsrOfkscdzozIFEKI2CARP7mCi_04Kessd1X688Gm3aEnQJMKIXPmhssJjdpOceCnLQ9dBB22pdPJ21t3ah1vpptnquwZq-Bo1gb0jUWV-w-96BBgDQNfSVn4CwbpulmQwuN6saTTNLTJU8SeiDeQlXPChVPq5FcE-RPav6jzKDMsN5ntXrg9t3VGbg7aAs_EDhuGVlhq9DuV5Z2JcT-lfJWznh9krvXfxV-vhOosxQJDfvJ4fAue1Uox8rcvgBym9DHc78DwAA__8Q13_6) since the camp filed for bankruptcy in June. Judge Christopher Lopez held off on the bigger question after a [nearly 12-hour hearing](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQRb_GdEYeA2a3cJGG7qVNicwwLM6zMbKHZfn7iEj5gjRTje695_z6Gr-cD357_XSRLH-WNG50lkDMlEd2wWWPKVM58uKQCrq4x6uMWmkjQUmA0SH7N42tq2Y7qfkJFVnon9CDMUpVq-2M0tgRdk3bdwimQb20qoduUQ8wD6q8veNAAQCoBp41TkCuMe3STtot3UO0imbPKde8EtPHlSVc6U25xhSrYFfmvYjmh9CD0MN5njUGj996TUfhtN1fQg83mNBDSOiC0MPdKfQA6t_5fcwvkjMFdxV5g8p4FfYoJ7d952NnvGQ-bllyI5qLjCmTZB9J6KHKdt5PH4IvphetekXnw995_L9a31b_CQAA__8AGI1G): whether the Eastland family keeps control of the bankruptcy or an independent trustee takes over. The hearing resumes Tuesday. Federal bankruptcy officials want a trustee, and liquidation is on the table. When I campaign, I talk to hundreds of families fed up with the status quo, and I am more confident than ever that this collective sentiment will power this movement to the finish line.

body:

name: Chris Deluzio
subject: The richest country in the history of the world
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Deluzio for Congress
body:
I'm talking about more than just affording your life -- which should be the floor of our ambition.
# [](https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1&akid=120%2E42639%2Ev4Rh7t)
One of the most consequential elections in modern American history takes place in less than a month, and at stake is nothing less than putting a check on Donald Trump's power by taking back the House and the Senate.
But success this November is not just about stopping Donald Trump, as important as that is.
This is not just about "winning" or defeating someone we may not like.
Let us not lose sight of the fact that this election takes place at a time when there is more wealth and income inequality than at any time in our nation's history.
This election takes place at a time when the wealthiest people in this country have never had it so good while the majority of Americans are living paycheck to paycheck.
This election takes place at a time when some people are dying or going bankrupt because they don't have the health care they need.
This election takes place at a time when almost a quarter of senior citizens are trying to get by on less than $15,000 a year, hundreds of thousands of Americans are homeless, students are leaving college with crushing debt, and the cost of everyday goods - including food - is going through the roof.
We live today in the richest country in the history of the world.
And in the richest country in the history of the world, if you are working hard and playing by the rules that ought to translate to a pretty good life.
Nothing crazy. I'm not talking about museum art in every home.
I'm talking about more than just affording your life -- which should be the floor of our ambition. I'm talking about:
🏡 A roof over your head
🗺️ Deciding to live where you want to live
📈 Pursue your passions and maybe start a business
⚽️ Put your kids in sports and activities
📚 Send them to a good school
🩺 To see a doctor when you need one
🏖️ Take a vacation now and again
👵🏼 Retire with some dignity
So this election is not just about defeating Donald Trump. It is about offering more.
We must do all we can between now and November to "win." And as the last Democrat representing a battleground district in Pennsylvania, I am doing all I can to hold this seat.
But if we are successful on November 3rd, that's when the work begins anew.
Let's get it done.
Don't give up the ship,
Chris Deluzio

Let us not lose sight of the fact that this election takes place at a time when there is more wealth and income inequality than at any time in our nation's history. This election takes place at a time when the wealthiest people in this country have never had it so good while the majority of Americans are living paycheck to paycheck. This election takes place at a time when some people are dying or going bankrupt because they don't have the health care they need. This election takes place at a time when almost a quarter of senior citizens are trying to get by on less than $15,000 a year, hundreds of thousands of Americans are homeless, students are leaving college with crushing debt, and the cost of everyday goods - including food - is going through the roof. We live today in the richest country in the history of the world. And in the richest country in the history of the world, if you are working hard and playing by the rules that ought to translate to a pretty good life. Nothing crazy. I'm not talking about museum art in every home. I'm talking about more than just affording your life -- which should be the floor of our ambition. I'm talking about: 🏡 A roof over your head 🗺️ Deciding to live where you want to live 📈 Pursue your passions and maybe start a business ⚽️ Put your kids in sports and activities 📚 Send them to a good school 🩺 To see a doctor when you need one 🏖️ Take a vacation now and again 👵🏼 Retire with some dignity So this election is not just about defeating Donald Trump. It is about offering more. We must do all we can between now and November to "win." And as the last Democrat representing a battleground district in Pennsylvania, I am doing all I can to hold this seat. But if we are successful on November 3rd, that's when the work begins anew. Let's get it done. Don't give up the ship, Chris Deluzio ☀️ Wait ... Before you click away! 🇺🇸 Chris Deluzio has won his elections in a competitive House district because of the support of grassroots supporters talking to voters, sharing information online, and donating what they can. If everyone getting this email contributed just $20 to his re-election, he would win this November with ease and put Democrats one step closer to taking back the House. Unfortunately, not everyone gives—so he's counting on people like you who know the stakes in this election to chip-in what they can. ---
Peter,
We know you’re likely getting a deluge of fundraising messages from campaigns (ours included) about the FEC deadline coming up in three days. We don’t blame you if it’s started to feel like another excuse to ask for donations – especially so soon after last month’s end-of-quarter push.
While public campaign finance deadlines may not make for good dinner-table conversation, they do have real stakes that matter down the line for working families.
That’s because they have a real impact on critical midterm races like ours – [**_which is why at the end of this email, we’re going to ask you to chip in to help Roy Cooper win in North Carolina._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1880&amount=5&t=8&akid=4404%2E124072%2EePSk64) But before we do, will you give us a chance to explain?
Campaigns like ours are required by law to periodically close our books and file our fundraising numbers with the Federal Election Commission. While it’s usually on a quarterly basis, the very last deadline is a few weeks before the election. In our case, it’s this Wednesday.
The idea here is transparency: These reports provide the public with a snapshot of who's funding candidates, how their support is growing and whether they have the resources to win. Since Senate control hinges on North Carolina, _everyone_ – from the press to our opponent and the dark-money super PACs on his side – will be watching when our report goes live. Our numbers will help them determine where their money is best spent in the last leg of the race.
Now, the GOP knows as well as we do that Roy has the momentum to flip North Carolina blue for the first time since 2008 – but Republicans have the money, and they’ve spent millions of it to defeat us and keep their majority for another two years (at least).
**If they detect any weakness in our numbers, it’ll give them incentive to spend millions more to drown us out entirely. That’s a risk we can’t afford so late in the race.**
We have to prove our grassroots movement is unstoppable – that we have the resources to run through the tape with the strongest voter outreach and mobilization program NC has ever seen.
**Since this is a people-powered campaign, the only way we do either is with your help to reach our $3 million goal by Wednesday night.**
[**_It’s time for all of us to dig deep, Peter, so if you’re able to make a donation today, we’d really appreciate it. Every dollar will immediately go to work reaching the voters we need to flip this seat blue in 23 days, take back the reins from MAGA Republicans and finally return power over the country to where it belongs: in the hands of working people._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1880&amount=5&t=9&akid=4404%2E124072%2EePSk64)

But timing is everything, especially in a close race like this.
We’re less than one month away from Election Day today. That means Dan Sullivan and his billionaire backers have less than a month to try to claw back their advantage in this race.
Over the next few weeks, they’re going to throw the whole book at us: Even more attack ads, smear campaigns, and outrageous amounts of dark money tearing their way through Alaska.

Everyone will be watching to see if we have the resources we’ll need to respond and turn these polls into power — especially when we’re already being outspent by DC Republican super PACs.
That’s why we need a huge number of donations today to show everyone watching that we can and will win this fight for our future.
We only have one shot at this last FEC report, so I’m counting on those of you who understand the importance of this moment to make a donation today before it’s too late. So I’m personally asking:

As long as we all work together, we will win Alaska’s U.S. Senate seat.
The strength of this campaign has always come from regular people stepping up when it counted. And it means a lot to me that so many of you have faith in our ability to win. Together, we’re building a movement.
Thanks for being a part of it.
\- Mary

Friend,

Most of the emails you get from me are about what's happening in Tallahassee and here in District 24. This one is different, and I want to be upfront about that.

Before I ever ran for office, I spent 30 years as an entrepreneur. I built businesses, made payroll, took risks, made mistakes, and learned a lot of lessons the hard way. Along the way, I began writing books, speaking, and advising leaders and business owners who wanted to grow. That world is still a big part of who I am, and it's a big part of why I fight for small business owners in the Legislature.

I've noticed that a lot of you who follow my work in office are entrepreneurs yourselves, or you have a son, daughter, or friend building something of their own. So I wanted to make you aware of something I'm doing for the first time.

Next Friday, October 16, in Tampa, I'm hosting a one-day Business Inner Circle. I've pulled together some of the highest-performing business people I've connected with over the years to teach on:

• Marketing
• Investing
• AI and social media
• Business tax strategies
• Scaling
• Memory (taught by a US Memory Champion)

I've kept it small on purpose. There are about 40 seats total, and only a handful are left. The real value is the room itself. The people you meet there become connections you keep for the rest of your life.

To be clear: this is not a political event and has nothing to do with my campaign. It's simply me sharing the other half of my world with people I think would get a lot out of it.

If this sounds like you, or someone you know, just reply to this email or write to contact@ryanchamberlin.com and I'll personally get you the details.

And if it's not for you, no worries at all. Thanks for letting me share it.

Grateful for you,

Ryan

P.S. If you know a business owner who's been stuck at the same level for a while, forwarding this to them might be the best favor you do them this year.

Ryan D. Chamberlin
Strategic Growth & Executive Advisor
Member - House of Representatives FL

body:
It's easy to assume that God measures our lives the way the world does.

| | | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0M_qnDAQB_CniTclf9ToIYeCCD38CmWhPYaYjO5ATEISd1-_SLsv0Ot8hw8z399f-sugx3D8MCcoLEW76PT7aaqLUI7oLHjYsqmgOeVjy2jLmDa24gt0bxqnBs6mfWpAMTkzySkXc_NUUm6cghjELKaxd2Zzu9mlYYNjwm0bNKhuj1HGGKdiGDszTRKoEXanFuaekZ5eyZkKHYaCDoqNMaXosaItXcxH49Wz1lSI-Eb4SviaocQrWyhdyrDFHDobT8LXN3jfuhigTUSsVz313z0ilpRjSWArhoPw8Y5OcHidRCxwGvT_htacyeARiFhu7LY-SQwVQiVi-cX0T9l-fzzaz2NNVi690XssoyQ9PW7xvqmp_9H0S_E_AQAA__8tuI6K)
---
Friend of Life, It's easy to assume that God measures our lives the way the world does. After all, we're constantly surrounded by messages telling us to accomplish more, earn more, influence more, and become more. Success is usually measured by what people can see...In Scripture, we see something entirely different. Again and again, God reminds us that He is looking for faithfulness. When Jesus told the parable of the talents, He didn't praise the servant who had the most abilities or the greatest opportunities. He commended the servants who were faithful with what had been entrusted to them. That truth has encouraged us many times at PreBorn!. Most of us will never be famous. We may never write a book that reaches millions, preach to a packed stadium, or lead a large ministry. But every one of us has opportunities each day to be faithful. Opportunities to love our families well, to serve our churches, to encourage someone who's hurting, to share the hope of Christ, and to use the gifts God has given us for His glory. Those moments may seem ordinary, but Scripture reminds us that they are anything but ordinary. They are part of a life that echoes into eternity. That's why we've created a free devotional called _[Hearing Jesus Say, "Well Done."](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyc0M_qnDAQB_CniTclf9ToIYeCCD38CmWhPYaYjO5ATEISd1-_SLsv0Ot8hw8z399f-sugx3D8MCcoLEW76PT7aaqLUI7oLHjYsqmgOeVjy2jLmDa24gt0bxqnBs6mfWpAMTkzySkXc_NUUm6cghjELKaxd2Zzu9mlYYNjwm0bNKhuj1HGGKdiGDszTRKoEXanFuaekZ5eyZkKHYaCDoqNMaXosaItXcxH49Wz1lSI-Eb4SviaocQrWyhdyrDFHDobT8LXN3jfuhigTUSsVz313z0ilpRjSWArhoPw8Y5OcHidRCxwGvT_htacyeARiFhu7LY-SQwVQiVi-cX0T9l-fzzaz2NNVi690XssoyQ9PW7xvqmp_9H0S_E_AQAA__8tuI6K)_ Over the course of ten days, you'll spend time in God's Word reflecting on what it means to live faithfully, steward your life well, and keep eternity in view. Each day includes Scripture, biblical teaching, guided prayer, and reflection questions to help you apply these truths to your own walk with Christ. When Jesus told the parable of the talents, He didn't praise the servant who had the most abilities or the greatest opportunities. He commended the servants who were faithful with what had been entrusted to them. That truth has encouraged us many times at PreBorn!. Most of us will never be famous. We may never write a book that reaches millions, preach to a packed stadium, or lead a large ministry. But every one of us has opportunities each day to be faithful. Opportunities to love our families well, to serve our churches, to encourage someone who's hurting, to share the hope of Christ, and to use the gifts God has given us for His glory. Those moments may seem ordinary, but Scripture reminds us that they are anything but ordinary. They are part of a life that echoes into eternity. Dear Fellow Conservative, You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children. You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on Blue's Clues...
---
Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses. Peter,
Last week, I debated my opponent, Dan Cox, and laid out exactly what’s at stake in this race. **But right now, I’d rather talk about what we’ve built together.**
In less than four years, we created nearly 65,000 new businesses and tens of thousands of jobs. We invested in our teachers and students, bringing reading and math scores to a five-year high. We drove violent crime to record lows.
The choice in November is clear: **Will we continue making progress for every Marylander? Or will we allow Dan Cox to bring his MAGA agenda to our state and undo it?**
I know which Maryland I’m fighting for, but I need you with me for these final 23 days.
**[Can you chip in $5 to help us finish what we started? I’m depending on this team to power our re-election campaign in the home stretch. **Here’s the thing, though: Many of these state-level elections are flying totally under the radar, which means we have plenty more work to do.**
Lots of people aren’t tuned in to what’s at stake on their ballot. That makes it even more important to rally resources and mobilize voters for these races. The good news is that, with smaller budgets in most of these elections, every contribution goes farther:
**Some of our Democracy Defenders’ elections will be decided by fewer than a thousand votes — your $25 donation could decide whether those final thousand voters get reached.**
[**A grassroots donation from you can make a bigger impact on these campaigns than in higher-profile elections. | | | On Friday, farmers from across the district joined forces to ask voters to fire John McGuire and to send me to Congress to fight for our rural communities. I am honored to have the support of Farmers for Tom, and ready to get to work to bring down input costs, stabilize markets, and protect rural health services. One of the largest cattle farmers in this area – a well-known Republican – spared nothing to blast McGuire: **“Farmers don't need another politician who shows up for photographs, puts on a pair of clean boots and tells us how much they appreciate agriculture. We've tried that with John McGuire. We've watched him say one thing and support the exact opposite.”** We had the national Black cattleman of the year make it very clear: **“We are all fed up with what's going on with the farming world, especially for the small farmers. We worked so hard to get where we are today and try to hold on.”**

The policy matters – Trump’s illegal tariffs and wars are crushing the small profit margins our farmers survive on. But this is also about respect. As one of our larger goat farmers in the region noted, she believes I have**“the salt to really take things forward. Because right now farmers are getting ghosted, as the kids say.”** I released my **[FED UP plan](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141177444/652707642/-1095303555?refcode=261011em_tp_farmers&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjIxMDkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZTE2ZDA2OTktNzhjNS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=c8HqMaEWcqXC4ENtNMjrqM2Af_GwZ7i-zXirjtHwPIs=&emci=9c4a0bac-71c5-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=e16d0699-78c5-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&ceid=18671963)** because I have spent months hearing from farmers from Appomattox to Albemarle and from Halifax to Louisa that they are fed up about skyrocketing input prices, destabilized markets, spikes to equipment costs, and insulting beef importations flooding US markets, just because the Argentine conglomerate wrote Trump a $5 million check, We can win this race, because we are not doing politics the conventional way. We are building a Coalition for Common Sense, house by house, sector by sector, across generations and geographies. We are building trust across groups that do not need to agree on every issue, but agree 100% on the most important issues – getting costs down, boxing in this President from doing more damage, and preventing a death spiral in health services. I am fired up to have Farmers for Tom spreading the good word across the district that change is in the air – that after a costly drought of no-show representation from McGuire, good news is on the horizon. We are not just going to flip this district. We are going to show that a better kind of politics is still possible. Not just possible, but necessary for what lies ahead. We believe that this news is a source of hope for a lot of people. It is a permission slip to thousands of our rural brothers and sisters who are ready to vote for change. With your resources, we are going to make a major digital buy, letting folks in our rural communities know about Farmers for Tom, know about my FED UP plan, and know that I am ready to fight for all of us. **Can you chip in today to fuel this work? | Friend, A little, it was revealed that the U.S. Postal Service is moving forward with a plan to limit mail-in voting by only sending ballots to voters who are registered on a list approved by the federal government. Now there is an even more alarming update:
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001X7fVis87_seO2zNIR8lfwAnZIiDSrt2jJNGmYMwkpBLs5Bqux2EKQYTFU9hQhDD0Kiy8TlGCHsH-mB59LYl7f2qPu4GEUatUA2NwjXGds6ga7yzwpgLlD7svxtg-Tw1jwrpVabG4USb4LnbE6gURwEz9bzLiUXBz1kQdRxNWYeQkE6ZFoSdL99gNlBUJZSwTeU6mPXetKzhjRXwwT4TBLhHnjj864Du4KnF2WL2pH9pkQis2EKrdz-Df0xaKlnSjc1TGRLzYNUn0g5j4SKYDEQ==&c=0Il1F3FuJFNdBX0DOXalHvAlYpgcDBIjhPxu_nAyPL_uha6jfqfy8g==&ch=JibKP_R3Mq7zqRg99Ht_iHPVikGoPimbPqpQ2zZIKsiE41iURxcW5g==)
---
| Donald Trump is using the United States Postal Service to strong-arm Democratic states into surrendering their voter lists. The threat is simple: hand over the data, or your voters' ballots do not get delivered. And those lists contain the names and home addresses of every registered Democrat in those states. We know exactly what MAGA does with voter data. In 2021, a dark money group called True the Vote challenged more than 364,000 Georgia voters just before the Senate runoff that handed Democrats the majority. Young voters and Black voters were twice as likely to be challenged, the same voters who flipped Georgia in 2020. A federal judge later ruled their data "utterly lacked credibility" and "verged on reckless." But getting caught does not stop dark money operations, it just sends them shopping for better data. There is no better data than official government voter records and Trump is delivering it. In April, it was revealed the Trump admin is secretly funneling seized voter data to political groups with a track record of trying to overturn election results:
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001X7fVis87_seO2zNIR8lfwAnZIiDSrt2jJNGmYMwkpBLs5Bqux2EKQYTFU9hQhDD0Kiy8TlGCHsH-mB59LYl7f2qPu4GEUatUA2NwjXGds6ga7yzwpgLlD7svxtg-Tw1jwrpVabG4USb4LnbE6gURwEz9bzLiUXBz1kQdRxNWYeQkE6ZFoSdL99gNlBUJZSwTeU6mPXetKzhjRXwwT4TBLhHnjj864Du4KnF2WL2pH9pkQis2EKrdz-Df0xaKlnSj0OhghGVgs5O4m5lH1jq1Nw==&c=0Il1F3FuJFNdBX0DOXalHvAlYpgcDBIjhPxu_nAyPL_uha6jfqfy8g==&ch=JibKP_R3Mq7zqRg99Ht_iHPVikGoPimbPqpQ2zZIKsiE41iURxcW5g==)
---
| The data pipeline is being established right now to rig the upcoming midterm elections. Trump uses the USPS to squeeze the states, the lists flow to dark money groups, and those groups mass-challenge Democratic voters off the rolls before the most important midterm of our lives. Legal challenges to this rule are coming, and they will land right where MAGA wants them: The U.S. Supreme Court. We have all seen how this Court rules. They overturned Roe. They gutted the Voting Rights Act. They handed Trump criminal immunity. This court has been fully exposed as a puppet of Trump and MAGA extremists, willing to torch a half-century of precedent to tilt elections their way. So ask yourself: do you trust this Supreme Court to stop Trump from weaponizing voter data against Democrats? Neither do we. This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists. Campaigns can look like they’re all about rallies, speeches, ads, and headlines. But the truth is, none of it happens without people like you who believe Ohio, and our country, are worth fighting for.
[If you’re able, I hope you’ll help us keep pushing all the way through the finish line:](https://trk.email.vivekforohio.-nkxWfR_aoy1k_6Bi1DQg)

Peter - I'm going to be straight with you, because that's the only way I know how to do this.

_We just won._ Two elections in two weeks: the special primary, then the runoff.

Grueling doesn't begin to cover it. Every dollar this campaign had went into turning out voters, running ads, and getting our message into every corner of this state.

**And it worked.**

But here's the part nobody tells you on election night: winning a runoff doesn't put a single dollar back in our account. Right now, after everything we just spent, our campaign finances are running on fumes.

**Annie Andrews has $4.1 million.**

She's raised nearly $11 million since she got into this race, from liberal donors across the country. She's had months to build that war chest while we were fighting a two-round primary just to get our name on the November ballot.

Countless conservatives in SC put their trust in me, and I promise to carry forward the conservative agenda for the next six years in the United States Senate. # They want you to think this race is over. It isn’t.
---
| | | | | | Friend,
Today the Albuquerque Journal and Research & Polling Inc. released a new poll, and R&P’s president, Brian Sanderoff, is already telling reporters that time is running out for our campaign.
I’m not buying it, and you shouldn’t either.
In the Journal’s last poll, we had a 17 point lead in the Las Cruces area. Now, somehow, that has completely flipped? **So which poll was flawed? The last one, or this one?**
Here’s what else you should know. Over nine days of calls, only one came after the debate my opponent skipped. Most of the people in this poll answered before New Mexicans saw me standing next to an empty lectern, answering questions she wouldn’t. The poll also builds its sample from 2024 voters, a presidential year when turnout is always far higher than in a governor’s race. A lot of those voters won’t cast a ballot this November.
We’ve seen this before. In the final week of our primary, the polls said it was close. **We won by 10.**
A poll like this does one thing: it tells Republicans and independents that the race is decided so they’ll stay home. That’s exactly what Deb Haaland needs to happen. **She has spent millions upon millions of dollars, much of it from out of state, and she still hasn’t moved the needle since August. She’s stuck.** A large share of independents haven’t made up their minds.

body:
We can’t take anything for granted.
#
Hi there,
There are less than 4 weeks to go until Election Day, and while Democrats are overall in a strong position to flip the Senate, there’s some nuance in what we’re seeing.
In several of our Must-Flip races—particularly North Carolina, Ohio, and Texas—Democrats are looking stronger and stronger. But one of our Must-Hold races, Michigan, is looking extremely close.
**Here’s a look at some of the latest polling numbers in _all_ of our Senate targets this cycle:**
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2625?t=1&akid=3103%2E1562180%2EY_abja)
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2625?t=2&akid=3103%2E1562180%2EY_abja)
To win Senate control, Democrats need to flip four Republican-held seats while holding on to their current seats in three battleground states. And Republicans aren’t making it easy. They’re pouring money into TV ads in many of these races, including more than $326 million spent in Texas alone. We need to make sure Democrats have the resources to respond to attacks and stay competitive.
**So with less than 4 weeks to go, we’re asking you to[donate any amount to our Win The Senate Fund today.](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2625?t=3&akid=3103%2E1562180%2EY_abja)**
**[Donate Now](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2625?t=4&akid=3103%2E1562180%2EY_abja)**
Your donation will be split between each of the candidates listed above, with a portion also going to Swing Left to support our efforts to have Ground Truth deep canvassing conversations in competitive states across the country.
Thank you, as always, for everything you do. Let’s get out there and win some elections!
– The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. subject: A reporter recently asked what I would say to those who feel discouraged by our politics:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
A reporter recently asked what I would say to people who feel discouraged by our politics.
Here is what I said: “We are going to turn this around, but it is going to take a lot of work – all of us banding together and turning out in higher numbers than we ever have.”
There is no shortcut, and nobody is coming to do it for us.
After spending four days in upstate New York, in places that stopped getting attention years ago, do you know what I noticed? **The rooms were full.**
When we give people a reason to participate, when we give people a reason and something to vote for, we can transform who turns out in elections and how we win them.
There are only 23 days until voters decide who controls the House and the Senate – and in some states, voters have been mailing back their ballots for weeks.
Will you make a $5 donation today? It helps us keep our campaign on the doors, on the phones, and on the road reaching voters:

| | | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=01208e16dbd1403e8dbedb08129441e7&_e=ciw7abm-rOia2M7TJmU8QUCMCIaNeTdfoJ09H_o3RasJu6S-BVezgRAslPWVhQ5VWtxz0J66uQj8hEhPIaiVCaAMwkxQDpBiP8gAf8zEbvVMbCG_W6usKbmX7nGuJnoKRBOR3BIF_N8aA7N67n2KsnIvgtr6UGsMvczAaYVvLZi9bqWL1GwliiXzWSckJme9OfU2C-LWq-0o0MXl0MvsG7uaR_6hEo7ilnF39kr4wI2Z3RnoeskYNzuTRotyzswzqM_eRuOaluGUnkG5eDtQ9mrX5HLfPt96jwcAn3fJ0yWecgyzCrey-FjIS-pUZ1ewFmwByVThZ7iKs9t8SVW-B5OyUooZSH7zKSfPlYQ0YKlGUIUC8-eSggSz_caOWb4_RMk3EEPTxw9tw4GLQgvpMb92n6OkmxMYxGxBN_yFwln6IH8CVDYryrYEDV49OXeaYJfrTES3Li5hmhEjgETtgJMnUGoRxzw8EYp8H3jrT0jnMyTZgr--RNMGGtkKz-Mv71KaqUgT3jTR4QtcKudnR6tZcfj4CR2NfUyZg_eLE0xVr--ukZq-rN5g8__Y3v_eqTyGruz6KgjJZrlS0VwXCS5CVil62m7UQevd4e_5FngdbIXjDxIdazQ1oBwqqnisOkaQ-gpprtZS-6LGzp_Alw1PHFA6CAd7-2ZkySj7xnUC1rfrbgLVMbfd02xbTRwas9Qj2-2czOsJzDmcE8zsdUlCyHsIgk1aNYTDDmYNdDY%3D)
---
| | Friend,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=01208e16dbd1403e8dbedb08129441e7&_e=ciw7abm-rOia2M7TJmU8QUCMCIaNeTdfoJ09H_o3RasJu6S-BVezgRAslPWVhQ5VWtxz0J66uQj8hEhPIaiVCaAMwkxQDpBiP8gAf8zEbvVMbCG_W6usKbmX7nGuJnoKRBOR3BIF_N8aA7N67n2KsnIvgtr6UGsMvczAaYVvLZi9bqWL1GwliiXzWSckJme9OfU2C-LWq-0o0MXl0MvsG7uaR_6hEo7ilnF39kr4wI2Z3RnoeskYNzuTRotyzswzqM_eRuOaluGUnkG5eDtQ9nE_IQNUWa_1z3btMhJc-EuS5miVjvGWE2c1OuU-mNklNj5WwFoLBs8QSB_V-pxFJNxDbXhLQUtrtN801OpYiG3ceenZVVaGcb20kSdQrylWiUerIL4yLVUFoRipALMrbuBYp20Zy9U4XbbtAl-WnxtwpHTTh9N3xRZBDinOf-eNjrE2A0NNx7EWVkKVnte2N9v8J5xR9yymY8t92aPuVc4Yvw_Nqkim68q-MU0YaZ3XXZkbj_Okgc-9rWDua0ENpLAnZG_aan2GihCbjHxSEVE1_YXGidFUxA5_Q-2ZO90UGOONKVWVmTAPSr9s3JHw4WAM7TzaMq7LL1NmYd6CpCNhpHZVciPpbUL4obCqhAvLiQdsiARJ4n8gnlqLan_jJkiHWJq0wGBbcrqEzZaFqXCXWKCBmGXy5A4M1jLBmfNczJr1KLedTnnSk4eQZQqHkJDBeuqz9im8Wja24CPEW4w%3D)
---
We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee
✅ Oklahoma
✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska
✅ Arkansas
✅ Indiana

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=01208e16dbd1403e8dbedb08129441e7&_e=ciw7abm-rOia2M7TJmU8QUCMCIaNeTdfoJ09H_o3RasJu6S-BVezgRAslPWVhQ5VWtxz0J66uQj8hEhPIaiVCaAMwkxQDpBiP8gAf8zEbvVMbCG_W6usKbmX7nGuJnoKRBOR3BIF_N8aA7N67n2KsnIvgtr6UGsMvczAaYVvLZi9bqWL1GwliiXzWSckJme9OfU2C-LWq-0o0MXl0MvsG7uaR_6hEo7ilnF39kr4wI2Z3RnoeskYNzuTRotyzswzqM_eRuOaluGUnkG5eDtQ9uQj2TlsJfr0BujF1JlOQvyejdWehrHFJJo_xGIQghlonFhf6aXcQW0XJi796Fyn3Ahvbe0EX2ZHdOn3Bj3GxBSKHSlWMISrVaOH7vBfUVTPMBggcklp72l1N8TQ8_CYcdXrOqQ3RxeSwPf-JbA0IBerudaiThxYuJwwaQh8HYuT2HjQEIJRa-SShBcbYqNyGVmkFh6liGebiUwShIbU-g7hZN4As6FS4r5sivAI2HnbTR_g4HdhRtL_tjlMKkFBvqFW2iT-oveX_AW_pSoJeDToMYfxicVFwF-mUHQk-BiWh01SIFCenYjcBi9eryok4KS185DQQk8BJGX6GBgH0Qc6P4164c1FXw2YnprlC9lV_XoqK0L4VkYoQ_5R70q-P-0m-kUc3zNmhBLgrM-2VPdeB1Dv1_77_Z80XEaRWdPSLB4ySG7EWxEVAuK7x5iopoWN_YRqxi9VFs_y2kG50cs%3D)
---
_But now, Friend, the question is... _

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.

**Every time a student starts a new chapter, we make sure they 're not standing alone. **

**We send them an activism kit -- American flags, pocket Constitutions, chapter materials, and leadership tools. **

These kits give student leaders everything they need to rally their peers and stand strong on their campuses.

Each one costs just $25 to pack and ship.

**[If you’re able to, I hope you’ll help send a kit to the next student who raises their hand to lead by making your gift to Turning Point USA today.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=01208e16dbd1403e8dbedb08129441e7&_e=ciw7abm-rOia2M7TJmU8QUCMCIaNeTdfoJ09H_o3RasJu6S-BVezgRAslPWVhQ5VWtxz0J66uQj8hEhPIaiVCaAMwkxQDpBiP8gAf8zEbvVMbCG_W6usKbmX7nGuJnoKRBOR3BIF_N8aA7N67n2KsnIvgtr6UGsMvczAaYVvLZi9bqWL1GwliiXzWSckJme9OfU2C-LWq-0o0MXl0MvsG7uaR_6hEo7ilnF39kr4wI2Z3RnoeskYNzuTRotyzswzqM_eRuOaluGUnkG5eDtQ9kffgu6-Se7OAZ2bpTeZbE0u8-JtsfTyqEwEWPACuhEaZKCYhMkC4XUgAGKh0r7trYq6S0NPX9Xf6ncfFWbew6_MNBLXEpMKORoDEp3U_NS2vV1R5J1buyvoWiXZWeUMflG4n8Q5GSINIxms0WZTeaJzbZj1Ou-CNu2gaI3j7zIEx7zqKm7ooCf9vsVhfh7nTSl2Oc4XGsJu2rWbjMZHpSffryrFtGspaO9IvkiTt0VKz6X-i_D5EsgqLNU7r-ai4Sc-RYwxQRlGh3O1qAcZRF-bUmTX4g1yXAVDAmp1o8wPES7TY3obABmyekfce7Wa7zzuN7Dr9wESSWqGJd5letTSmGpUUDeIzi19ZZbW713dXOuwXIZjaynTtThIUMEYAm13RMj-7Z4EAn8EQEYE3Y13tjToZkvFZ8RyUCtT3ldRHT3a-Eawn3QjsDo1-I89FCTKR-TR5pkuO4fbHAwOxco%3D)**

Team Abdul
